title: On-behalf-of: the gateway swaps the caller token for one minted for the backend
lede: Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. The agent calls the gateway; the gateway exchanges the caller token at the issuer (RFC 8693) for one whose audience is the backend, and the backend validates a token issued to it. Mock only; values invented.

edges.label: token for the backend, with act

steps.title: Agent calls the gateway
steps.what: The agent presents the token it was issued. The gateway verifies it: signature, issuer, expiry, audience, a named user.

steps.title: Gateway asks to exchange it
steps.what: The gateway sends the caller token to the issuer as the subject token, with the backend as the resource and a scope no wider than the caller holds.

steps.title: A token minted for the backend
steps.what: The issuer answers with a new token. Its aud is the backend, its sub is still the user, and act names the caller (an earlier act nests beneath it).

steps.title: Gateway calls the backend
steps.what: Only the exchanged token is forwarded. The caller's own token never reaches the backend.

steps.title: Backend validates a token issued to it
steps.what: The audience is the backend, so it accepts; it logs the user and the acting agent instead of a shared service account.
